$comment: The `unsafe` tokens each registry dependency's source carries, across both Cargo workspaces (root and crates/fuzz) and every platform the lockfiles resolve, read by `cargo xtask unsafe-ledger` (QR-28c). The count is a lexer's: every `unsafe` keyword outside comments and literals, used or not, so it over-counts and measures arrival, not risk. Shrink-only: a count above its ceiling fails until the entry is raised BY HAND with its reason updated, after someone has read what arrived; a count below fails until `--update` banks it; a crate with unsafe and no entry, or an entry for a crate gone from the tree, fails. A reason says where the crate sits (shipped, build time, xtask, fuzz) and what the unsafe is for. Measured 2026-11-06.

arbitrary.reason: fuzz only (libfuzzer-sys's build or runtime), never shipped: structured-input derivation for fuzz targets

bitflags.reason: xtask only, never shipped: flag types under wasmparser

bumpalo.reason: build time only (inside a proc macro the wasm build runs), never in an artifact: arena allocator of wasm-bindgen-macro-support

cc.reason: fuzz only (libfuzzer-sys's build or runtime), never shipped: compiles libFuzzer's C++; process and job-server plumbing

find-msvc-tools.reason: fuzz only (libfuzzer-sys's build or runtime), never shipped: cc's MSVC discovery (Windows registry FFI)

foldhash.reason: xtask only, never shipped: hasher under wasmparser's indexmap

getrandom.reason: fuzz only (libfuzzer-sys's build or runtime), never shipped: OS randomness FFI, reached only through cc's jobserver

hashbrown.reason: xtask only, never shipped: the hash table under wasmparser's indexmap

indexmap.reason: xtask only, never shipped: wasmparser's ordered map

itoa.reason: xtask only, never shipped: integer formatting inside serde_json

jobserver.reason: fuzz only (libfuzzer-sys's build or runtime), never shipped: make job-server client used by cc (fds, signals)

libc.reason: fuzz only (libfuzzer-sys's build or runtime), never shipped: libc bindings under cc/jobserver/getrandom

libfuzzer-sys.reason: fuzz only (libfuzzer-sys's build or runtime), never shipped: the libFuzzer entry symbol and its FFI

memchr.reason: xtask only, never shipped: SIMD byte search inside serde_json

proc-macro2.reason: build time only (inside a proc macro the wasm build runs), never in an artifact: token-stream plumbing of every derive

r-efi.reason: fuzz only (libfuzzer-sys's build or runtime), never shipped: UEFI bindings of getrandom, for a target never built

rustversion.reason: build time only (inside a proc macro the wasm build runs), never in an artifact: version-conditional attributes used by wasm-bindgen

semver.reason: xtask only, never shipped: version parsing in wasmparser

serde.reason: xtask only, never shipped: serde's derive and data model (also counts `unsafe` in generated-code templates)

serde_core.reason: xtask only, never shipped: serde's core traits

serde_json.reason: xtask only, never shipped: JSON reading of cargo metadata and the ledgers

shlex.reason: fuzz only (libfuzzer-sys's build or runtime), never shipped: shell-word splitting inside cc

syn.reason: build time only (inside a proc macro the wasm build runs), never in an artifact: Rust parser of every derive; mostly the `unsafe` keyword as a TOKEN it parses, not unsafe code

unicode-ident.reason: build time only (inside a proc macro the wasm build runs), never in an artifact: identifier tables for proc-macro2

wasm-bindgen.reason: SHIPPED in the wasm artifact: the JS/wasm ABI glue (externref table, closures, string passing) is unsafe by nature; the one runtime dependency of whiteboard-wasm, pinned with the CLI

wasm-bindgen-macro-support.reason: build time only (inside a proc macro the wasm build runs), never in an artifact: #[wasm_bindgen] expansion; mostly `unsafe` inside the code it GENERATES, which wasm-bindgen's count stands for

zmij.reason: xtask only, never shipped: float formatting inside serde_json
